changelog:
Major skill redesign for focused, automated Xiaohongshu operations and monitoring:

- Simplified skill scope to competitive monitoring, influencer tracking, content alerts, and trend discovery
- Automated collection and de-duplication of competitor and influencer posts with scheduled runs
- Feishu notifications for new posts, including title, summary, engagement stats, and direct link
- Highlights trends via hot topic and feed analysis, enables discovery of rising creators
- Data-driven suggestions for optimal content types, posting times, and high-performing titles/covers
- Includes updated guidance for browser session management and security best practices

Legacy content creation, research, and SOP materials removed for a streamlined ops toolkit.
